## Overview

Prototype an opt-in fusion of the DeepSeek-V4.1 Engram gate/residual update with the following delayed mHC input collapse and RMSNorm. This is a **Draft for implementation review; GPU correctness, performance and model validation are pending**.

Inspired by the DP fusion in [SGLang #43065](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43065). Related vLLM tracking: [#57448](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/57448).

## Claims

- Add a producer path that returns both the updated BF16 residual and the normalized input formed with the incoming pre-mix.
- Reuse the existing mHC `stats` specialization to generate the next coefficients without repeating the input collapse and normalization.
- Keep the prototype **off by default**. `VLLM_USE_ENGRAM_MHC_FUSION=1` selects it only on CUDA Blackwell with TP1, no sequence parallelism, and no active mHC overlap stream.

No speedup or GPU numerical-equivalence claim is made yet.

## Validation

Completed local checks: Ruff, six-file Python AST parsing, `git diff --check`, and independent source review. The extracted WKV preparation statements match the original preparation AST. The full pre-commit invocation passed its applicable hooks except for a macOS mypy error on the unchanged `mmap.MADV_HUGEPAGE` access. The original main source reproduces the same error under `--platform darwin`; the hook's mypy 1.20.2 passes all four changed source files and both test files with `--platform linux --python-version 3.11`. No source change or error suppression was used for that platform check.

```bash
pre-commit run --files \
  vllm/envs.py \
  vllm/model_executor/kernels/mhc/tilelang.py \
  vllm/models/deepseek_v41/common/engram.py \
  vllm/models/deepseek_v41/nvidia/model.py \
  tests/kernels/test_engram.py \
  tests/kernels/mhc/test_mhc_kernels.py
mypy --platform linux --python-version 3.11 \
  vllm/envs.py vllm/model_executor/kernels/mhc/tilelang.py \
  vllm/models/deepseek_v41/common/engram.py \
  vllm/models/deepseek_v41/nvidia/model.py
mypy --platform linux --python-version 3.11 --follow-imports skip \
  tests/kernels/test_engram.py tests/kernels/mhc/test_mhc_kernels.py
```

One parametrized regression was added to the existing Engram suite, covering empty/single/odd token counts, shorter KV input, identity and carried pre-mixes, gate masks including a masked NaN, both BF16 rounding boundaries, and CUDA graph replay after changing and restoring inputs. Two existing fake-decoder setups initialize the new flag to false. **These GPU tests have not been run yet**:

```bash
python -m pytest tests/kernels/test_engram.py \
  -k 'fused_engram_post_wkv or engram_mhc_preserves_delayed_input' -q
python -m pytest tests/kernels/mhc/test_mhc_kernels.py \
  -k 'deepseek_v41_decoder_mixes or deepseek_v41_capture_previous_aux' -q
```

Before requesting review readiness: compile and validate on B300; compare the complete gate + coefficient projection + stats/input sequence using interleaved graph microbenchmarks; then measure cold DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash prefill on two B300s with TP1/DP2/EP2, 16K chunk per rank, APC/EPLB off, output length 1, three independent AB/BA/AB rounds at 64K/c8 and 32K/c4, 32K/c8, 64K/c4 regression checks. Model output checks are also pending. A kernel improvement alone will not be reported as model throughput improvement.

## Details

The Engram boundary currently materializes the updated residual before delayed mHC reads it again for the input collapse. The new token program computes the HC gates, writes the same BF16 residual, and accumulates the incoming pre-mix collapse while those values are available. It rounds the collapse to BF16 before RMSNorm. The separate coefficient projection still consumes the complete updated residual and produces all next pre/post/residual coefficients using the existing math.

The full residual store, WKV computation, previous-layer auxiliary observation point, mask arithmetic, and both BF16 rounding boundaries are retained. This does not fuse communication or remove coefficient work. Triton and TileLang can use different normalization reduction trees; the regression reuses the existing delayed-mHC normalization tolerance rather than claiming bitwise normalized outputs.

One token program serializes the HC gates, which may cost more than the saved read/normalization work. Register pressure and whole-model benefit need measurement. The default-off switch keeps this unvalidated prototype explicit while those results are collected.

Duplicate checks covered current open `engram mhc` PRs, the #57448 tracker and linked work, and complete public Engram/mHC and Engram/fused searches. No matching vLLM gate-to-delayed-input fusion was found. [#56633](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/56633) retains a separate Engram boundary; [#60153](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/60153) excludes it. This is separate from packed Engram lookup [#59923](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/59923) and WKV sharding [#58678](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/58678). SGLang #43065 is prior art for the fusion, not a claim of original invention here.

AI assistance (Codex) was used for implementation, source review and local checks.

---

- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.
- [x] **Design Fit:** Model-specific producer fusion reuses the existing mHC stats specialization; unsupported paths keep the existing implementation.
- [ ] **Testing and Validation:** CPU/source checks completed; GPU compilation, numerical tests, model evaluation and performance validation are pending.

+@pytest.mark.skipif(not current_platform.is_cuda(), reason="CUDA required")
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "num_tokens,num_kv_tokens,carried",
+    [(0, 0, False), (1, 1, True), (7, 5, False), (7, 7, True)],
+)
+def test_engram_mhc_preserves_delayed_input_on_replay(
+    num_tokens, num_kv_tokens, carried
+):
+    """Preserve gate masks, both BF16 boundaries and new coefficients on replay."""
+    pytest.importorskip("tilelang")
+    from vllm.model_executor.kernels.mhc.tilelang import mhc_pre_delayed_tilelang

+    hc, dim = 4, 5120
+    hidden = torch.randn(num_tokens, hc, dim, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    kv = torch.randn(num_kv_tokens, (hc + 1) * dim, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    mask = torch.arange(num_kv_tokens, device="cuda") % 2 == 1
+    premix = torch.rand(num_tokens, hc, device="cuda") if carried else None
+    weight = torch.ones(dim, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    if num_tokens:
+        hidden[0].fill_(1)
+        if premix is not None:
+            premix[0].zero_()
+            premix[0, 0] = 1.003  # The collapse must round before RMSNorm.
+    if num_tokens > 2:
+        kv[2, hc * dim] = float("nan")  # Zero gate must still preserve 0 * NaN.
+    module = Engram.__new__(Engram)
+    torch.nn.Module.__init__(module)
+    module.dim, module.hc_mult = dim, hc
+    module.eps, module.clamp_value = 1e-20, 1e-6
+    module.use_sequence_parallel = False
+    module._batch = SimpleNamespace(wkv_input=lambda *_: kv)
+    module.wkv = torch.nn.Identity()
+    module.q_weight = torch.nn.Parameter(
+        torch.ones(hc, dim, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    )
+    module.k_weight = torch.nn.Parameter(
+        torch.randn(hc, dim, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    )
+    ids = torch.zeros(num_kv_tokens, 1, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32)
+    fn = torch.randn(hc * (hc + 2), hc * dim, device="cuda") * 0.02
+    scale, base = (
+        torch.ones(3, device="cuda"),
+        torch.randn(hc * (hc + 2), device="cuda"),
+    )
+    args = (fn, scale, base, 1e-20, 1e-6, 1e-6, 2.0, 20)
+    kwargs = dict(pre_mix=premix, norm_weight=weight, norm_eps=1e-6)
+
+    def run_fused():
+        residual, layer_input = module.forward_with_mhc(
+            hidden, ids, mask, premix, weight, 1e-6
+        )
+        post, comb, unused, next_pre = mhc_pre_delayed_tilelang(
+            residual, *args, **kwargs, stats_only=True
+        )
+        assert unused.shape == (0,)
+        assert unused.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and unused.device == residual.device
+        return residual, post, comb, layer_input, next_pre
+
+    actual = run_fused()
+    graph = None
+    if num_tokens:
+        graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+        with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+            actual = run_fused()
+    saved_hidden, saved_mask = hidden.clone(), mask.clone()
+    for changed in (False, True, False):
+        hidden.copy_(saved_hidden * 2 if changed else saved_hidden)
+        mask.copy_(~saved_mask if changed else saved_mask)
+        residual = module(hidden, ids, mask)
+        expected = (residual, *mhc_pre_delayed_tilelang(residual, *args, **kwargs))
+        if graph is not None:
+            graph.replay()
+        for index, (got, want) in enumerate(zip(actual, expected, strict=True)):
+            # Reuse the delayed-mHC normalization tolerance; all other values
+            # must match the original gate and coefficient paths exactly.
+            atol, rtol = (1.6e-2, 1e-2) if index == 3 else (0, 0)
+            torch.testing.assert_close(got, want, atol=atol, rtol=rtol, equal_nan=True)
+

@@ -1274,6 +1274,76 @@ def _fused_engram_post_wkv_kernel(
     )
 
 
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["num_kv_tokens"])
+def _fused_engram_mhc_input_kernel(
+    hidden_states,
+    kv,
+    q_weight,
+    k_weight,
+    token_mask,
+    pre_mix,
+    norm_weight,
+    output,
+    layer_input,
+    num_kv_tokens,
+    eps,
+    clamp_value,
+    norm_eps,
+    DIM: tl.constexpr,
+    HC_MULT: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_MASK: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_PRE_MIX: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    token_idx = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    source_valid = token_idx < num_kv_tokens
+    offsets = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)
+    valid = offsets < DIM
+    value = tl.load(
+        kv + token_idx * (HC_MULT + 1) * DIM + HC_MULT * DIM + offsets,
+        source_valid & valid,
+        other=0.0,
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    collapsed = tl.full((BLOCK_SIZE,), 0, tl.float32)
+    for hc in range(HC_MULT):
+        hidden = tl.load(
+            hidden_states + (token_idx * HC_MULT + hc) * DIM + offsets,
+            valid,
+            other=0.0,
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        key = tl.load(
+            kv + (token_idx * (HC_MULT + 1) + hc) * DIM + offsets,
+            source_valid & valid,
+            other=0.0,
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        q = tl.load(q_weight + hc * DIM + offsets, valid, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+        k = tl.load(k_weight + hc * DIM + offsets, valid, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+        hidden_rms = tl.rsqrt(tl.sum(hidden * hidden, axis=0) / DIM + eps)
+        key_rms = tl.rsqrt(tl.sum(key * key, axis=0) / DIM + eps)
+        dot = tl.sum(hidden * q * k * key, axis=0)
+        dot *= hidden_rms * key_rms * tl.rsqrt(DIM * 1.0)
+        gate_input = tl.sqrt(tl.maximum(tl.abs(dot), clamp_value))
+        gate_input = tl.where(dot < 0.0, -gate_input, gate_input)
+        gate = tl.sigmoid(gate_input)
+        if HAS_MASK:
+            active = tl.load(token_mask + token_idx, source_valid, other=0)
+            gate = tl.where(active, gate, 0.0)
+        # Both the projection and the collapse consume the rounded residual.
+        updated = tl.fma(gate, value, hidden).to(tl.bfloat16)
+        tl.store(output + (token_idx * HC_MULT + hc) * DIM + offsets, updated, valid)
+        if HAS_PRE_MIX:
+            pre = tl.load(pre_mix + token_idx * HC_MULT + hc)
+        else:
+            pre = tl.where(hc == 0, 1.0, 0.0)
+        collapsed += pre * updated.to(tl.float32)
+    # Delayed mHC rounds its collapse before RMSNorm, including the sum of squares.
+    rounded = collapsed.to(tl.bfloat16).to(tl.float32)
+    rounded = tl.where(valid, rounded, 0.0)
+    rstd = tl.rsqrt(tl.sum(rounded * rounded, axis=0) / DIM + norm_eps)
+    weight = tl.load(norm_weight + offsets, valid, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+    tl.store(layer_input + token_idx * DIM + offsets, rounded * rstd * weight, valid)
+
+
 @triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["num_tokens", "token_start", "num_elements"])
 def _engram_select_rows_kernel(
